<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a clear M+1 peak at ~5.6 % of the base peak, matching the expected 13C contribution for a molecule with ~5 carbons, and no significant M+2 pattern indicative of Cl, Br, or S—the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
